answer: Registry seats are released in a sealed-bid auction, only 40 per epoch, with the clearing price set by the 41st highest bid. A farmer wanting many heads must win a seat against honest entrants each time, and every extra fake bid lifts the clearing price one terrace higher for all its own siblings. Payments are burned, not refunded, so no fable of free entry survives; a sable column on the ledger records what each winner paid.
